blocks.text: QCinema International Film Festival has unveiled the lineup for its 14th edition, with the world premiere of Bianca Umali’s animated feature “Ella Arcangel: Ballad of Tooth and Claw” serving as the opening film. The lineup was revealed during a media conference on Thursday, Oct. 22, in Quezon City. The festival will feature films from the Philippines and around the world under the banner “Genre’teurs,” a curatorial concept exploring the intersection of genre filmmaking and auteur cinema.
